plain_english_policy: This bill directs Etowah County to transfer specific funds received from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) into the Sheriff's Law Enforcement Fund, rather than retaining them or using them for other purposes within the county commission.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would legally mandate that all monies paid by Etowah County to ICE be deposited into a specific law enforcement fund established in 1987. It also validates any payments made since October 2004 and ensures these funds continue to be used according to the original rules of that 1987 act.
sponsorship_supports_position: The bill is sponsored by Representatives Galliher, Ford, and Page. Their sponsorship indicates they affirmatively advanced this specific local legislation regarding fund allocation in Etowah County.
evidence_quotes: Etowah Co., monies received by county commission from U. S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement to be paid into Sheriff's Law Enforcement Fund, retroactive effect
Any and all monies paid to the Sheriff's Law Enforcement Fund from sources identified in Section 1 shall continue to be paid to the fund
